model_identity: claude-opus-5-5 through Claude CLI 2.1.295 print mode; tools, MCP servers, hooks, plugins, skills and project instructions disabled; one fresh non-persistent session per decision
working_directory: Empty scratch directory under /tmp/cbl-policy-cwd per decision, outside any project tree; removed after the call
output_normalization: A single outer ```json fence is stripped and recorded as fence_stripped; no other repair. Non-JSON or over-budget output is rejected and retained.
output_enforcement: Posthoc shared-tokenizer cap; overlong raw outputs are retained with provider usage and rejected before execution. Provider usage and cost are reported from the CLI JSON envelope.
model_identity_scope: Requested model name and effort; actual served model names are recorded from modelUsage per decision; no sampling seed is exposed.
